MX.name: Yerba mansa
MX.citation: Native range confirmed to include Baja California and central/northern Mexico (Southwest Desert Flora; Flora of the Southeastern United States). Unlike 'yerba santa', this name is genus-monotypic (Anemopsis has only one species) and does not carry the same cross-species collision risk

US.name: Yerba mansa
US.citation: USDA NRCS Plant Guide, Anemopsis californica (symbol ANCA10)
